instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_014_handle_blank.step, a handle blank with two cylindrical end bosses of diameter 18 mm and height 8 mm, centered at X=-32 and X=32, connected by a rectangular bridge spanning X=-32 to X=32, Y=-12 to Y=12, and Z=0 to Z=8. Remodel the bridge so its upper surface is a cylindrical ergonomic arc of radius 10 mm running along X, centered on Y=0 and Z=10, with highest point at Z=20, which is 12 mm above the end-boss top face. Cut a 5 mm through mounting hole along Z at the center of each end boss. Add 0.8 mm fillets to exposed outside edges. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_014_handle_ergonomic_out.step.
